explain: fetch fires just as often (26 of 32 cycles in both traces), but look at out_valid. With fetch ≫ exec ≫ drain, an item is fetched, moved to stage 2 and drained in the same cycle, so v1 and v2 are already clear at the end of every cycle. out_valid, which the interfaces rule reads at the start of the cycle, stays 0 while items stream through and are consumed unseen. The registers no longer separate the stages. With later stages first, each item spends a cycle in each register, and the consumer sees every item.
